lines.zh: 沙粒从我的裹布缝隙漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks through the gaps in my wrappings.

lines.zh: 每一步都压碎一层干沙。
lines.en: Each step crushes a thin crust of sand.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘脊上慢慢挪动。
lines.en: I drag myself along the dune ridge.

lines.zh: 布条在热风里沙沙作响。
lines.en: My bandages rustle in the hot wind.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进松软的沙里。
lines.en: My feet sink into the loose sand.

lines.zh: 沙暴的尘土留在我裹布上。
lines.en: Sandstorm dust settles on my bandages.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子走过盐碱地。
lines.en: I drag my shadow across the salt flats.

lines.zh: 热风把我身上的气味吹散了。
lines.en: The hot wind scatters my scent.
I close in on the oasis one step at a time.

lines.zh: 干裂的地面在我脚下碎开。
lines.en: The cracked ground breaks under my feet.
I crawl out of the tomb entrance.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我关节里磨得发响。
lines.en: Sand grinds loudly inside my joints.

lines.zh: 我的裹布后面拖着虫壳。
lines.en: Beetle shells trail behind my wrappings.

lines.zh: 我绕过一棵枯死的棕榈树桩。
lines.en: I circle around a dead palm stump.

lines.zh: 我沿墓道往外，走得很直。
lines.en: I walk straight out along the tomb hall.
My wraps loosened; I pull them tight.
I stand still and let the sand settle.
Something crawls beneath my ribs.

lines.zh: 我数着远处商队的铃声。
lines.en: I count the caravan bells far away.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙干得发不出声。
lines.en: My throat is too dry to make a sound.

lines.zh: 我把松开的布条缠回去。
lines.en: I wind a loose bandage back into place.

lines.zh: 记忆里的太阳比现在更毒。
lines.en: The sun in my memory burned worse.

lines.zh: 一只蝎子钻进我的袖口。
lines.en: A scorpion slips into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我闻到了墓室里的尘土味。
lines.en: I smell the dust of my burial chamber.

lines.zh: 一只圣甲虫在替我放哨。
lines.en: A scarab keeps watch on my behalf.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己裂开的指骨。
lines.en: I look down at my cracked finger bones.
The wind carries my name away.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只需要等待。
lines.en: I do not need breath, only waiting.

lines.zh: 你也想被裹成木乃伊吗。
lines.en: Do you want to be wrapped like me?

lines.zh: 活人的皮肉味太新鲜了。
lines.en: Living flesh smells too fresh.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我的还要暖。
lines.en: Your shadow is warmer than mine.

lines.zh: 我认得你腰间那件金饰。
lines.en: I recognize the gold at your belt.
Stand back; your sweat draws insects.

lines.zh: 你眼里还留着墓外的光。
lines.en: Your eyes still hold daylight.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你不跑吗。
lines.en: I have watched you long; why not run?

lines.zh: 你的骨头会保存得不错。
lines.en: Your bones will keep rather well.
You do not look like a desert traveler.
I can smell the water in your flask.
A length of my bandage is torn.
It hurts, but I forgot how to cry out.
You knocked the sand off me.
You made my old bones ring.
That stirred up my insects.
I will remember this scar.
Another piece of my skin falls away.
You broke cloth a thousand years old.

lines.zh: 你的刀划开了一层裹布。
lines.en: Your blade sliced through a layer of my wrappings.
The pain only makes me want you more.
The shine of gold can stop my steps.

lines.zh: 给我纸，我要写旧的祷文。
lines.en: Give me paper to write the old prayers.
Rotten flesh is not fine, but not bad.

lines.zh: 你把金子放在沙上就走。
lines.en: Leave the gold on the sand and go.
I need fresh cloth to wrap myself.
That gold nugget is catching light.

lines.zh: 我愿意用秘密换一块纸。
lines.en: I would trade a secret for paper.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西闻起来很旧。
lines.en: What you hold smells very old.
I am hungry, yet I want the gold more.
Place the offering at the tomb door.
Bump me and you will wear sand.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀硬得像石棺盖。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard as a coffin lid.
Do not shove; my wrappings will come loose.
You knocked off a layer of dry cloth.
I stand firm; you do not.

lines.zh: 这一下让我身上的虫醒了。
lines.en: That woke the insects under my skin.
You stepped on the top of my foot.
I gave you a chance to step aside.
Collisions sound muffled in the dunes.
Do that again and I will grab you.

lines.zh: 我寻找另一个不腐的伴侣。
lines.en: I seek another companion who does not rot.

lines.zh: 两个人一起守墓更安静。
lines.en: Two of us guard the tomb more quietly.

lines.zh: 你身上的香膏味很像我。
lines.en: Your embalming scent is like mine.

lines.zh: 我们可以在沙下并排睡。
lines.en: We could sleep side by side under sand.

lines.zh: 我已经独自走了很多年。
lines.en: I have walked alone for many years.

lines.zh: 我的祷文需要有人回应。
lines.en: My prayers need someone to answer them.

lines.zh: 你愿意共守这座空墓吗。
lines.en: Will you share this empty tomb with me?
Two scarabs would count as a dowry.
I will teach you how to wrap cloth.

lines.zh: 我们不需要誓言，只要沙。
lines.en: We need no vows, only sand.
I fold this paper against my chest.
The gold is mine; it was in the sand.
This scrap of flesh will feed the beetles.
I pick up a strip of old cloth.

lines.zh: 落下的金锭不会自己走。
lines.en: A dropped ingot does not walk away.
I keep the bone shard as an ornament.
This paper carries someone else's writing.
I tuck the thing into my wrappings.
You dropped it, so I call it an offering.
The scarab wants this piece of hide.
Something warm is coming closer.
My fingers begin to itch.
Someone is crunching sand over there.
The swarm told me you arrived.

lines.zh: 我听见水袋晃动的声音。
lines.en: I hear a water flask sloshing.
This prey is worth rising for.
The footprints ahead are still fresh.
I smell rust in the sand.
A living thing appeared outside the tomb.

lines.zh: 我的脊背朝那个方向转了。
lines.en: My spine turns toward that direction.
Metal clinks somewhere in the distance.
I will call a few beetles to me.

lines.zh: 我在算你走到墙边要几步。
lines.en: I am counting your steps to the wall.
However fast you run, you will thirst.
I wait for you to turn your back.
Hunger will catch you before I do.
The sand will remember your path.
My scarabs are already taking flight.
Scarabs are crawling out of my bandages.
I have fixed on your throat.
Do not expect the sun to save you.
I herd you toward the quicksand.
The beetles gather beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你已经是墓里的东西了。
lines.en: You already belong to the tomb.
My fist carries tomb dust.
This blow makes your hunger bite sooner.

lines.zh: 裹布下伸出的手抓住了你。
lines.en: A hand slips from my wrappings and grips you.
One strike from me and you weaken.

lines.zh: 干瘪的指节敲在你肋骨上。
lines.en: My shriveled knuckles rap your ribs.

lines.zh: 我伤口里的虫也咬了你。
lines.en: The insects in my wounds bite you too.
You hear your own stomach growl.

lines.zh: 我不用兵器，只要碰到你。
lines.en: I need no weapon, only to touch you.

lines.zh: 沙从我的袖口洒在你脸上。
lines.en: Sand pours from my sleeve onto your face.

lines.zh: 我的诅咒顺着抓痕进去了。
lines.en: My curse enters through the scratches.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘下顶开了石板。
lines.en: I push the slab open from beneath the dune.
The thousand-year seal has finally cracked.

lines.zh: 沙漠今夜多了一个守墓人。
lines.en: The desert gains a gravekeeper tonight.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里亮起。
lines.en: My eyes light up in the dark.
Sand slides down my wrappings.
I wake with my mouth full of dirt.

lines.zh: 有人动了不该动的棺材。
lines.en: Someone moved a coffin that should rest.

lines.zh: 我从墓道的裂缝里爬上来。
lines.en: I climb out through a crack in the passage.
The sandstorm covered my way out.

lines.zh: 沉睡的岁月全压在我背上。
lines.en: The sleeping years weigh on my back.
Fire will burn my last wrappings.

lines.zh: 落地时我听见骨头在响。
lines.en: On landing I hear my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 水渗进裹布，我沉得更快。
lines.en: Water soaks my wraps and I sink faster.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀走了我半截手臂。
lines.en: The blast tore half my arm away.
The arrow is stuck between my shoulder blades.

lines.zh: 魔法灼穿了我干枯的皮。
lines.en: Magic burns through my dried skin.

lines.zh: 饥饿是我唯一的老朋友。
lines.en: Hunger is my only old friend.
Lightning scorched my wrappings black.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙可以落脚。
lines.en: There is no sand to stand on in the void.
